definitions.gloss: secret art; secret technique; arcane skill
definitions.explanation: A technique or method that is kept hidden and passed down only to select individuals. Often refers to traditional arts, martial arts, or crafts transmitted within a lineage.

examples.japanese: ⟦{師匠|ししょう}→師匠：12421_shishou⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{秘術|ひじゅつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{伝授|でんじゅ}→伝授：14955_denju⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I was taught the secret technique by my master.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{流派|りゅうは}→流派：13365_ryuuha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{門外不出|もんがいふしゅつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{秘術|ひじゅつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: This school has secret techniques that must never be shared outside the school.

examples.japanese: ⟦{古|ふる}く→古い：00488_furui⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{伝|つた}わる→伝わる：01961_tsutawaru⟧{秘術|ひじゅつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{用|もち}いて→用いる：02314_mochiiru⟧、{名工|めいこう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{誰|だれ}→誰：00534_dare⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{真似|まね}→真似：03736_mane⟧⟦できない→できる：00557_dekiru⟧⟦{作品|さくひん}→作品：02776_sakuhin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{生|う}み{出|だ}した→生み出す：10423_umidasu⟧。
examples.english: Using secret techniques passed down from ancient times, the master craftsman created works that no one could imitate.

notes:
A compound of {秘|ひ} (secret, hidden) and ⟦{術|じゅつ}→術：14265_jutsu⟧ (art, technique, skill). Carries connotations of something carefully guarded, often with a sense of mystique or tradition.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {秘術|ひじゅつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{伝|つた}える→伝える：01220_tsutaeru⟧ — to pass on a secret technique
- {秘術|ひじゅつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{伝授|でんじゅ}→伝授：14955_denju⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ — to transmit a secret art (to a disciple)
- {秘術|ひじゅつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{駆使|くし}→駆使：14682_kushi⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ — to make full use of secret techniques
- {門外不出|もんがいふしゅつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{秘術|ひじゅつ} — a secret technique never revealed outside the school

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{秘伝|ひでん}→秘伝：13779_hiden⟧ — secret tradition or recipe; often used for culinary secrets (⟦{秘伝|ひでん}→秘伝：13779_hiden⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦タレ→タレ：10500_tare⟧ = secret sauce recipe)
- ⟦{奥義|おうぎ}→奥義：14935_ougi⟧ — the deepest secrets of an art; the ultimate technique in martial arts or traditional disciplines
- {秘技|ひぎ} — secret skill; similar to {秘術|ひじゅつ} but often used in sports and martial arts contexts

REGISTER:
Formal and literary. Commonly appears in historical fiction, martial arts contexts, and descriptions of traditional crafts. Also used figuratively in modern Japanese to describe any impressive or closely guarded skill.
